about: Baby Lugia's shiny colours are Paolo's own (2026-10-07): the same wild Baby Lugia as baby_lugia_pictures.json, its personality the same from the pinned RNG, comes out shiny under the trainer ID 462822871 (the one that makes bramblin_pictures_shiny.json's foe shiny), and front1.lift finds its front in the shiny colours its back's PNG carries, one row over the ground line as the normal one stands. The save is a scratch copy of Paolo's Route 29 save put on Route 30 with a Baby Lugia leading.
